tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: JPEG screenshot of a display.

tools.name: zoom
tools.description: Region of the last screenshot at full resolution.

tools.name: left_click
tools.description: Left click at coordinate or the cursor.

tools.name: right_click
tools.description: Right click at coordinate or the cursor.

tools.name: middle_click
tools.description: Middle click at coordinate or the cursor.

tools.name: double_click
tools.description: Double click at coordinate or the cursor.

tools.name: triple_click
tools.description: Triple click at coordinate or the cursor.

tools.name: left_click_drag
tools.description: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.

tools.name: mouse_move
tools.description: Move the cursor without clicking.

tools.name: left_mouse_down
tools.description: Press the left button at the cursor.

tools.name: left_mouse_up
tools.description: Release the left button at the cursor.

tools.name: cursor_position
tools.description: Cursor position in screenshot pixels.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll at coordinate or the cursor.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text at the keyboard focus.

tools.name: key
tools.description: Press a key or combination (Return, ctrl+s) repeat times.

tools.name: hold_key
tools.description: Hold a key or combination for duration seconds.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Pause for duration seconds.

tools.name: ui_tree
tools.description: Accessibility tree of the foreground window, one line per element id; since=last: changes only.

tools.name: ui_find
tools.description: Find elements: name words, role:<role>, state:<state>; at most 20 lines.

wait_ms.description: Wait up to this long for a match

tools.name: ui_act
tools.description: Act on an element id from ui_tree or ui_find.

tools.name: window_list
tools.description: Visible top-level windows: handle, title, process, rectangle.

tools.name: window_focus
tools.description: Bring a window to the foreground, restoring it.

tools.name: window_set
tools.description: Move, resize, minimize, maximize or close a window; rect [x, y, w, h] in screenshot pixels of display (default: the window's).

force.description: With state closed: end the process after 2 s

tools.name: app_launch
tools.description: Start a Start menu app (name or AUMID) or open a document or folder in its default app; returns the window and its tree.

tools.name: clipboard
tools.description: Read (get) or write (set) the clipboard's text; content marked secret by its app is refused, and set keeps it out of the history and cloud.

text.description: mode set: the text, 1 MiB at most

tools.name: registry_read
tools.description: Read a registry value (name; empty for the default) or a key's values and subkeys, 64-bit view; never writes. path: HKCU\..., HKLM, HKCR, HKU or HKCC.
